note: Diagnostic, not a measurement. The 30B MoE truncates 99% of responses at both 8192 and 16384 tokens (identical 0.992 rate, response_lengths filling whatever cap is given) with reward 0.0 and mis_ppl_ratio 1.32-1.78. Raising the cap did not help, so the generation is degenerate rather than merely long. The remaining hypothesis is that the weights the SGLang engine serves differ from the trainer's -- the MoE online weight update is the one path that is MoE-specific and known fragile here. miles ships --check-weight-update-equal for exactly this, so ask it directly instead of inferring from downstream metrics.

cells.name: 30b_wcheck
cells.note: Asserts trainer and engine weights match after the update. A failure here explains the reward-0 generation and means the 30B mismatch numbers were never measuring quantisation.
